stem.text: The diagram shows some structures used for transport in the phloem.

stem.alt: Diagram of cell Y above a companion cell, cell Z, a phloem sieve tube, a direction of transport arrow and a long distance bracket

A.text: Cell Y is the sink cell.

B.text: Cell Z can be above or below cell Y in the plant.

C.text: Cell Z must be in a photosynthetic tissue.

D.text: Cell Y allows glucose to move to the sieve tube via the companion cell.
